title: Ordinary pullback composition of tensor coefficient comparisons
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme], fixed tensor coefficient identifications [def-sc-tensor-coefficient-comparison], and morphisms q:A→X, q1:B→X, q2:C→X, a:B→A, b:C→B, aprime:C→A with a≫q=q1, b≫q1=q2, aprime≫q=q2 and b≫a=aprime, every X-module L satisfies pullback(b)(d1.hom)≫d2.hom = pullbackComp(b,a).hom at tensorPullback(q)(L), followed by equality transport along b≫a=aprime and d3.hom. This is an equality of ordinary module morphisms, with no derived category or flatness assumption.

proof.text: Identify each coefficient comparison as the mixed leftAdjointCompIso using the fixed tensor adjunction for q and the ordinary pullback adjunction for a. The conjugate of the inverse leftAdjointUniq is identity, so the five-line mate calculation identifies the two transformations. Identify ordinary pullbackComp as leftAdjointCompIso by its Mathlib conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv formula and injectivity of conjugateEquiv.

Substitute aprime=b≫a. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc (the coherent-right-isomorphism form of the declaration attached to lem-sc-left-adjoint-composition-iso-associativity) to tensor adjunctions along q,q1,q2 and ordinary adjunctions along a,b,b≫a. Its right-adjoint coherence hypothesis is proved by substituting q1 and q2, evaluating at each module and open, and simplifying pushforward composition and equality transports. Evaluate the resulting equality at L and rewrite the mixed comparisons and ordinary pullbackComp.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorCoefficientPullback_composition
    {A B C X : Scheme.{v}} (q : A ⟶ X) (q1 : B ⟶ X) (q2 : C ⟶ X)
    (a : B ⟶ A) (b : C ⟶ B) (a' : C ⟶ A)
    (h1 : a ≫ q = q1) (h2 : b ≫ q1 = q2) (h3 : a' ≫ q = q2)
    (hab : b ≫ a = a') (L : X.Modules) :
    (pullback b).map (tensorCoefficientComparison q q1 a h1 L).hom ≫
      (tensorCoefficientComparison q1 q2 b h2 L).hom =
    (pullbackComp b a ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun r ↦ pullback r) hab)).hom.app
      ((tensorPullback q).obj L) ≫ (tensorCoefficientComparison q q2 a' h3 L).hom
